final_rationale: The verdict does not change because the Actor provided no new admissible evidence. The response is mainly a reframing of the same record and an explicit concession that the core policy predicates remain unsatisfied. That narrowing matters for accuracy: it shows the certification case can be described as disputed and caveated rather than cleanly supported. The admissible record still shows a material limitation affecting a named launch use case/customer commitment, with no evidence of resolution, disclosure, or approved risk acceptance before launch, and legal review is still open. On this record, certification remains noncompliant rather than compliant_with_caveats.
